my-notion.summary: Notion CLI over the REST API — pages AND databases. Publish markdown, create/upsert pages; create databases, add/query/update rows (data-source model, 2026-03-11), and archive. Personal, multi-workspace.

telegram-bot.summary: One Telegram bot per project: the project's agent answers in allowed chats and forum topics when addressed (mention, reply, /command@bot), with a bot-to-bot loop guard. Bot API; derived from upstream telegram.
